div.head: VIII Atr 7
div.ab: And wite Cristenra manna gehwilc, þæt he his Drihtene his teoþunge, a swa seo sulh þone teoðan æcer gegá, rihtlice gelæste be Godes miltse ⁊ be þam fullan wite, þe Eadgar cyninge gelagode.
And wite Cristenra manna gehwilc, þæt he his Drihtene his teoþunge, a swa seo sulh þone teoðan æcer gegá, rihtlice gelæste be Godes miltse ⁊ be þam fullan wite þe Eadgar cyningc gelagode.
And wite Cristenra manna gehwilc, þæt he his Drihtene his teoþunge—a swa seo sulh þone teoðan æcer gega—rihtlice gelæste be Godes miltse and be þam fullan wite þe Eadgar cyningc gelagode.

Und beachte jeder der Christenmenschen, dass er seinem Herr[gott] seinen Zehnten rechtmässig, immer, sowie der Pflug den zehnten Acker überschreitet, leiste, bei der Gnade Gottes und bei der vollen Strafe, die König Eadgar gesetzlich angeordnet hat.

And let every Christian man take heed that he pays his tithe to his Lord rightly, always as the plough passes over the tenth acre, on [pain of losing] God's favour and on the full penalty which King Edgar laid down.

And every Christian man, in order to obtain the mercy of God, shall see to it that he duly renders his tithes to his Lord, namely, in every case, the produce of every tenth acre traversed by the plough, or else he shall incur the full penalty which King Edgar instituted by law.

And for the grace of God, every Christian must understand that he is to offer up his tithes properly to the Lord— always to be a one-tenth yield of every acre traversed by the plow—or suffer the full penalty set forth by King Edgar.
